description: This file defines in-memory transport components for Orleans testing, including connection factories, listeners, and hubs to simulate network behavior in tests.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportListener
classes.description: Implements in-memory connection listening and accepting logic for testing, managing connection queues and lifecycle.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnectionHub
classes.description: Manages registration and retrieval of connection listeners based on endpoints.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnectionFactory
classes.description: Creates client connections to in-memory listeners for testing purposes.

methods.name: UseInMemoryConnectionTransport
methods.description: Extension methods for configuring silo and client builders to use in-memory transport.

methods.name: CreateInMemoryConnectionFactory
methods.description: Factory method to create in-memory connection factories.

methods.name: CreateInMemoryConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Factory method to create in-memory connection listener factories.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Establishes an in-memory connection to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Binds a listener to a specific endpoint.
